SwissArmyGrid 1.3.1: the table's name has its line to itself.

## Install or update

```bash
uv tool install --force "swissarmygrid[server]"   # the server
uv pip install -U swissarmygrid                   # the client, in your project's environment
```

## Fixed

- The grid's title showed the table's name and the steps strip side by side. The name now has its
  own line, with the steps strip (Undo, Clear, Edit steps, Copy as SQL / Python, To notebook) under it.
